Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, win As Window, v As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    wb.Worksheets.Add After:=wb.Worksheets(1)
    wb.Worksheets.Add After:=wb.Worksheets(2)
    wb.Worksheets(1).Activate
    Set win = wb.Windows(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
    Case 1
        wb.Worksheets(2).Activate
    Case 2
        wb.Worksheets(Array(1, 3)).Select
    Case 3
        wb.Worksheets(Array(3, 1, 2)).Select
    Case 4
        win.ActiveSheetView.DisplayGridlines = False
    Case 5
        win.ActiveSheetView.DisplayFormulas = True: win.ActiveSheetView.DisplayZeros = False
    Case 6
        win.ActiveSheetView.DisplayHeadings = False: win.ActiveSheetView.DisplayOutline = False
    Case 7
        wb.Worksheets(Array(1, 3)).Select: win.SheetViews(2).DisplayGridlines = False: wb.Worksheets(3).Activate
    Case 8
        win.DisplayGridlines = False
    Case 9
        Set v = win.ActiveSheetView: wb.Worksheets(2).Activate: v.DisplayGridlines = False: wb.Worksheets(1).Activate
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(win.ActiveSheetView)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & win.ActiveSheetView.Sheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & win.ActiveSheetView.DisplayGridlines
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & win.ActiveSheetView.DisplayFormulas
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & win.ActiveSheetView.DisplayHeadings
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & win.ActiveSheetView.DisplayOutline
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & win.ActiveSheetView.DisplayZeros
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(win.ActiveSheetView.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(win.ActiveSheetView.Application)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(win.SheetViews)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & win.SheetViews.Count
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & win.SheetViews(1).Sheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & win.SheetViews(2).Sheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & win.SheetViews(3).Sheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & win.SheetViews(0).Sheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & win.SheetViews("Sheet1").Sheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(win.SheetViews.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(win.SheetViews.Application)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & win.SheetViews.Item(1).Sheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & win.DisplayGridlines
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & wb.ActiveSheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = "ok " & Mid(s, 2)
Closed:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Closed
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = 0 To 9
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
